title: Welcome to Kabul
description: Airport reception and hotel transfer, with sightseeing scheduled around your flight arrival time: Babur’s Gardens in autumn colour, the old quarter of Murad Khane and Kahfroshi Bird Market. Food & culture: Afghan kabob.

title: Kabul’s Historic Heritage
description: A full Kabul heritage day linking the Kabul National Museum, Darulaman Palace, Sakhi Shrine and the view across the city from TV Tower Hill. Food & culture: Qabuli palaw.

title: Kabul to Ghazni: The Ancient Ghaznavid Capital
description: Road transfer by private 4WD to Ghazni, once the capital of the Ghaznavid empire. The Ghazni Minarets, the Ghazni Citadel, the Tomb of Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni and the traditional bazaar. Food & culture: local specialties and Afghan green tea. [OWNER REVIEW: Ghazni overnight availability and road-day feasibility.]

title: Ghazni to Kandahar
description: Overland travel through Zabul Province with scenic and appropriate roadside stops, then arrival and orientation in Kandahar, time permitting. Food & culture: Kandahari kabob. [OWNER REVIEW: road-day feasibility.]

title: Kandahar: History, Pomegranates and Traditions
description: The Mausoleum of Ahmad Shah Durrani; the Shrine of the Cloak, seen from outside where permitted; Chilzina, the Forty Steps; and the Arghandab Valley. In season, a Kandahar pomegranate harvest experience. Food & culture: Kandahari cuisine and pomegranates.

title: Kandahar to Kabul
description: A full-day road transfer through Zabul, Ghazni and Wardak back to Kabul. Food & culture: bolani. [OWNER REVIEW: road-day feasibility.]

title: Kabul to Bamyan
description: Road transfer into the central highlands, through the Wardak Highlands when the route permits, then the Buddha Niches and Bamyan Market. Food & culture: aush.

title: Ancient Bamyan
description: Shahr-e-Gholghola, Shahr-e-Zohak and Dragon Valley. Food & culture: mantu.

title: Band-e-Amir
description: Band-e-Amir National Park, subject to access; Koh-e-Baba mountain scenery; and the Bamyan dairy and qurut experience. Food & culture: qurut.

title: Bamyan to Kabul
description: The return road journey to Kabul, optional Chicken Street shopping, and a traditional Afghan farewell meal.

title: Departure
description: Breakfast, then the airport transfer with departure assistance.
